description: This file contains the implementation of the UserDao interface, providing data access methods for User entities, including retrieval by username and ID, listing users, and listing users by merchant store.

classes.name: UserDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserDao interface providing data access methods for User entities, extending generic DAO implementation.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by its username, joining related groups, merchant store, and default language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by its ID, with related group, merchant store, and default language fetched.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all User entities with related groups, merchant store, and default language, ordered by ID.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Lists Users associated with a specific MerchantStore, ordered by ID.
